title: Ops priming checklist and oddities - week of 2026-12-14
content:
Context:
Quick sync notes from ops + infra sync focused on pre-surge priming, oddball latency signals from APAC edge, and an abbreviated checklist to hand to oncall for the next 48–72h. This is intentionally terse — working doc for shift leads and capacity scouts.

High-level summary (TL;DR):
- Edge priming run scheduled for 12/15 03:00 UTC (APAC-heavy). Target: raise available queued slots by 18% across ap-northeast and ap-southeast.
- Observed anomaly: tail p99 TCP backlog spikes correlating with ephemerally high small-batch traffic (steady-state 1.2k/s -> burst 6k/s).
- Immediate mitigations: enable short-term connection pooling on allocator v2, temporarily reduce max-concurrent-inference per-slot from 12->8 in APAC pools.

Recent metrics snapshot (12/14 08:20 UTC):
- APAC (ap-northeast): GPU util median 61%, p95 latency 210ms, p99 latency 1.3s, queue depth avg 46 -> burst 190.
- US-WEST: GPU util median 72%, p95 150ms, p99 820ms, queue depth avg 21.
- Coldstart rate (24h): 2.8% globally, APAC 4.9% (up from 2.1% last week).

Key observations / oddities:
1) Short-lived control plane stalls: ~4 incidents last 48h tied to autoscaler reconciliation lag when reclaiming preemptible slots. Logs show longer GC pauses on node-label sync. (See INFRA-4821).
2) Small-batch storm pattern: internal crawler + some customer traffic produced many short requests (<=8 tokens). These underutilize batch windows and flood connection table, increasing TCP backlog.
3) Aggregate KV cache thrash on models with high prefix reuse — eviction storms cause intermittent latency spikes at p99.

Immediate action checklist (owners + ETA):
- Toggle allocator connection pooling flag to 'sticky' for APAC pools (owner: Ethan Wong) — target: 2026-12-15 02:30 UTC.
- Roll back recent autoscaler JVM flag change on spot-provisioner (owner: Priya Patel) — target: 2026-12-15 04:00 UTC. Linked: INFRA-4912.
- Short-term slot cap: reduce per-slot concurrent inference (APAC) to 8 (owner: Luca Moretti) — implement via fleet policies, target: 2026-12-15 03:00 UTC.
- Increase KV cache TTL for models flagged in /infra/kvcandidates.txt (owner: Maya Thompson) — target: 2026-12-16 EOD.

Runbook excerpts to include in next handoff:
- Surge entry criteria: sustained 3x queue depth over 5m or p99 latency > 1s AND coldstart rate > 3% for 15m.
- Priority actions: (1) enable slot cap, (2) route new requests to US fallback pool if compatible model exists, (3) set autoscaler snooze to 10m, (4) enable graceful rejection for low-priority tenant tags.
- Escalation ladder: oncall -> infra-sre lead -> capacity-pager -> eng-infra manager.

Risks & unknowns:
- Risk: reducing per-slot concurrency increases per-token cost; finance will flag if sustained beyond 12h. We need a cost-impact estimate if cap persists.
- Unknown: root cause of GC pause variance during node-label reconciliation; could be interaction with config-sync agent. Needs a controlled repro.

Notes on experiments & playbook tweaks (short):
- Experiment A: connection-pooling sticky mode (safe) vs multiplexed (default). Hypothesis: sticky reduces connection churn at cost of less multiplexing efficiency. Instrumentation: per-conn lifetime, conn reuse ratio, p99 latency.
- Experiment B: adaptive batch window increase of +5ms during observed small-batch storms. Pros: better batch fill, cons: slightly higher median latency for small requests.

Open questions for next sync:
- Are there tenant patterns we can mark as "low-priority short-burst" to proactively shed during priming? (action: product + solutions eng to supply list)
- Can console show per-region queue depth heatmap by tenant tier? (action: observability team)
- Should we add a scheduled priming job (pre-warm) before predictable traffic windows (e.g., APAC business hours)? Cost-benefit analysis needed.

Follow-ups (owners / tickets):
- Create cost impact estimate doc for slot cap (owner: Samira Khan) — target: 12/17.
- Post-priming retro capture: quick log of before/after metrics + decision timeline (owner: Ethan Wong) — target: 12/16. Link PR for allocator changes.
- Reproduce GC pause: collect heap dump during reconciliation in staging and run GC profiler (owner: Priya Patel) — target: 12/18.

Meeting attendees: Samira Khan, Ethan Wong, Priya Patel, Luca Moretti, Maya Thompson, Jason Li (oncall).

Appendix — quick command snippets:
- Check queue depth: curl -sS https://ops-api.internal/queues?region=ap-northeast | jq '.queues|map({slot:.slot,depth:.depth})'
- Toggle cap: infractl set-pool-policy --region ap-northeast --max-concurrent 8 --note "short-term priming"

Notes-to-self: if sticky pooling helps, schedule a controlled A/B for other regions but incremental; document cost delta clearly for finance review.

End of notes. Save this as the oncall handoff doc for 12/15 priming window and iterate after retro.
